name: CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy
summary: 腾讯的编程 agent（CodeBuddy Code 命令行、WorkBuddy 桌面版）：查看会话、状态和完整对话；WorkBuddy 桌面版可从手机发消息、新建任务（Mac）；命令行在 tmux 中运行、或由 Kiteline 在后台运行时可回复、确认、回答提问和中断
summaryEn: Tencent's coding agent (CodeBuddy Code CLI and the WorkBuddy desktop app): view sessions, status and full conversations; send messages to and create WorkBuddy desktop tasks from your phone (Mac); reply, confirm, answer questions and interrupt when the CLI runs in tmux or in the background through Kiteline

cli.note: 回复和确认需要 CodeBuddy Code 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）

desktop.note: WorkBuddy 桌面版：查看任务和完整对话；从手机发消息、新建任务时 Kiteline 用它的深链接打开任务、粘贴并发送（会短暂切到 WorkBuddy）；确认操作请在 WorkBuddy 中进行

cli.note: 从手机操作暂未开放（Windows 上还没实测），只能查看

desktop.note: WorkBuddy 桌面版的任务只能查看（Windows 上从手机发消息还没实测）

cli.note: 回复和确认需要 CodeBuddy Code 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）

desktop.note: WorkBuddy 桌面版的任务只能查看（Linux 版还没实测）

limitsNote: CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy 按积分计费，积分用量只能在网页的「用量」页查看，本机不记录、也没有查询接口，「今日用量」中不显示；token 按本机记录统计
limitsNoteEn: CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy bill in credits, which you can only check on the Usage page of their website; nothing is recorded on your computer and there's no query interface, so they aren't shown under Today's usage. Tokens are counted from local records
speaker: CodeBuddy
notes: 改进 Windows 上找会话的办法；从手机操作 Windows 上的会话在实测通过前暂不开放，设置 → 插件中有说明。
notesEn: Better session detection on Windows; controlling Windows sessions from your phone stays off until tested, as noted in Settings → Plugins.

gaps.text: Windows 上从手机回复、确认、中断还没实测，暂未开放，只能查看（Kiteline 已能往 Windows 终端里发按键，逐家实测后开放）
gaps.textEn: Replying, confirming and interrupting from your phone on Windows aren't tested yet, so they're off and sessions are view-only (Kiteline can now type into Windows terminals; each agent is enabled once tested)

gaps.text: Mac 上还没实测（Linux 上已全部实测）
gaps.textEn: Not yet tested on Mac (fully tested on Linux)

gaps.text: WorkBuddy 桌面版只在 Mac 上实测过（Windows、Linux 版还没实测）
gaps.textEn: The WorkBuddy desktop app has only been tested on a Mac (the Windows and Linux versions haven't been tested yet)

gaps.text: WorkBuddy 桌面版里等你确认的操作（权限、提问）要在 WorkBuddy 中处理：它没有对外的确认接口
gaps.textEn: Approvals and questions in the WorkBuddy desktop app have to be answered in WorkBuddy: it offers no external interface for them
